basic_details.job_title: DDU Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital (DDU Hospital) has announced 4 vacancies for Senior Resident - Orthopaedics and Senior Resident - Dermatology posts on an adhoc basis. Eligible candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 28.10.2026 between 09:30 A.M. to 11:00 A.M. at Admn. Block 1st Floor, Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital. Applicants must possess a Post Graduate Degree (MS/DNB) in the relevant discipline. The notified pay for both posts is Level 11 (Rs. 67,700/- - Rs. 2,08,700/-) plus admissible allowances, and the engagement is on an adhoc basis for 89 days till regular appointment of SR, whicheve

content_sections.heading: DDU Hospital Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not mention an application fee.

rows.details: Admn. Block 1st Floor, Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital, Hari Nagar, New Delhi-64
As per 7th CPC pay matrix level 11 (Rs. 67,700/- - Rs. 2,08,700/-) and other admissible allowances per month
Candidates who fulfill the eligibility criteria for per Residency scheme of the GOI and the qualification/eligibility criteria, aged up to 45 years

content_sections.heading: About DDU Hospital Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital is located at Hari Nagar, New Delhi-64 (Phone No. 011-25494401-08, Email: [email protected] ). The office of the Medical Director is conducting walk-in interviews for filling up vacant posts of Senior Residents (Adhoc) in the below mentioned departments on the basis of exigencies under the Residency Scheme of Govt. of India.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidate must have valid DMC Registration Certificate of MBBS (Delhi) (Mandatory) along with Registration of their PG degree/Diploma with DMC or "Applied for receipt of their PG Degree/Diploma DMC as on the date of Interview. Age limit is 45 years as on date of interview as per order no. F. No. DHF&W/Q015/57/2016-HR-Medical-Secy (H&FW) CD No. #11245062/1502-08 dated 26-11-2020. Age limit is relaxable by 05 years for SC/ST candidates and 03 years for OBC (Non Creamy Layer) (Delhi) as per rule. 4% seats shall be reserved for physically handicapped persons as per rules. OBC/EWS certificates issued from Govt. of NCT of Delhi shall only be accepted. OBC certificate from Govt. of NCT of Delhi should mention their belonging to Non Creamy Layer for that financial year. In case of SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate reveals that the claim to belong to these categories is fake/false the services will be terminated forthwith without assigning any further reason and without prejudice to such further action as may be taken under the provisions of Indian Penal Code for production of fake/false certificate. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to bring application, 02 passport size photos, Matriculation and Sr. Secondary Certificate, MBBS degree and Mark sheets, MD/DNB/Diploma, Mark sheets and Certificate, Residence Proof & DMC Certificate, Experience, if any. Original & Photocopies of all the requisite documents is required to bring at the time of interview along with the checklist and application form. Application Form 02 passport size photos D.O.B (10th Certificate) Caste Certificate / EWS Certificate (In Case of OBC - Delhi OBC alongwith NCL is required and in case of EWS (Delhi) for current F.Y) Sr. Secondary School Certificate (12th Certificate) MBBS Marksheets & Degree Post MBBS DMC Registration Certificate PG Marksheets & Degree Post PG DMC Registration Certificate SRship, If Any Aadhar Card No. Address Proof NOC from present employer if working on regular basis

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Document verification will be done between 09.30 A.M. to 11.00 A.M. in Admn. Block 1st Floor, Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital. Mode of selection will be through interview only. In case of number of applications are very high the interview may be continues on the next day. NO TA/DA will be paid to the candidates called for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When will the DDU Hospital Senior Resident Walk-in Interview 2026 be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and document verification are scheduled for 28.10.2026 between 09:30 A.M. and 11:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the venue for the DDU Hospital Senior Resident interview?
faq.answer: The venue is Admn. Block 1st Floor, Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital, Hari Nagar, New Delhi-64.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in DDU Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 04 total vacancies: 02 for Orthopaedics and 02 for Dermatology.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for DDU Hospital Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Degree (MS/DNB) in Orthopaedics or Dermatology respectively.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DDU Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 45 years as on date of interview as per order no. F. No. DHF&W/Q015/57/2016-HR-Medical-Secy (H&FW) CD No. #11245062/1502-08 dated 26-11-2020, with relaxations of 05 years for SC/ST and 03 years for OBC (Non Creamy Layer) (Delhi) as per rule.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Senior Residents at DDU Hospital?
faq.answer: As per 7th CPC pay matrix level 11 (Rs. 67,700/- - Rs. 2,08,700/-) and other admissible allowances per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the adhoc contract?
faq.answer: Walk-in-interview for the post of SR on adhoc basis (for 89 days) till regular appointment of SR, whichever is earlier (and noted as 44 days on adhoc basis or till regular candidate joins in whichever is earlier under general terms).

faq.question: Q8. Will application forms be provided at the interview venue?
faq.answer: No application form will be provided at the time of interview; candidates must download the application form annexed for appearing in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Within how many days must selected candidates join DDU Hospital?
faq.answer: Selected candidates shall be allowed to join within 07 working days from the issue of the offer letter failing which the offer shell stand automatically cancelled.
